decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed works would not result in harm to the appearance of the site or harm to neighbouring residents living conditions in accordance with policies ENV-N.1.2 (Retention of Playing Field), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities, C.2.1 (Educational Facilities), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The approved ball court shall only be used by the school and shall not be used separate from the school or used by members of the public not associated with the school out side school hours in the evenings or at weekends.
description: Construction of a multi-use ball court on an existing section of the playfield incorporating the erection of an inclosure
